structured.answer: Harel has a huge list (105 products), but the S&P 500 track keeps coming up in קופת גמל להשקעה, קרן השתלמות and גמל at about 0.5–0.56% a year with "13.7% 3 שנים / 11.9% 5 שנים", so that's the one I'd go for, though I'm not committing today.
